purpose: Isolate the training horizon and vendor residual target while preserving the original Moirai checkpoint, partitions, optimizer, learning rate, and number of steps.
selection_policy: Exploratory factorial comparison. Report all planned seeds and both temporal partitions. Do not select a favorable configuration or seed on test results.
gradient_policy: Truncate gradients through predictions fed back into the recursive decoder. Preserve the released decoder's forward values and optimize pinball loss over all 96 output steps.
comparison: Compare each 96 step arm with the matching seeds of the frozen 64 step Moirai run. The new arms are compared with each other at identical seeds and evaluation origins.
